old.dataset/TRAIN.md:
# Train and bring the model back to the portal

pip install ultralytics
cd dataset
yolo obb train data=data.yaml model=yolo11n-obb.pt imgsz=1024 epochs=50 batch=4
yolo export model=runs/obb/train/weights/best.pt format=onnx imgsz=1024 opset=17 simplify=True

Then in the portal: Detect > Load ONNX model > pick best.onnx.
Class names, in order: ship

No GPU? Upload this folder to Google Colab or Kaggle and run the same commands.
old.dataset/data.yaml:
path: .
train: images/train
val: images/val
names:
  0: ship

limitations: Logical reservations and transfer bytes are not measured browser/native/GPU RAM. No whole-process leak-free claim.
The controlled responsiveness fixture spends 60 ms per inference window; live-model runs establish small-scene equivalence, not a throughput or labelled-accuracy benchmark.
Native worker and model report source fingerprints match final production files. Each compatibility report retains its own captured source fingerprints.
Normal CI/deployed parity, physical constrained devices, Firefox/Safari, device-loss and sustained memory/thermal checks remain pending.
Application model sessions release per job; reusable idle caching/deduplication/content and metadata identity remain GMD-010 Planned.
